query:
SELECT usage_kind::text AS "kind!", COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "count!"
             FROM asset WHERE kind = 'datatable' AND usage_kind <> 'job'
             GROUP BY 1
           UNION ALL
           SELECT 'job_recent'::text, COUNT(DISTINCT (workspace_id, path))::BIGINT
             FROM asset
             WHERE kind = 'datatable' AND usage_kind = 'job'
               AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
